perceptual_review.method: inspected the actual capture files and the live sandboxed viewer captures
captures: live document 209 at 1440x900 dark and 390x844 light
observations: Five columns read left to right: externals (GitHub, Mattermost), the farm01 server block, the worker host. The CI path runs GitHub, CI observation, Accountability, Cooperation runtime, worker serve, native adapters; repair push returns over the top to GitHub.
The Mattermost plane reads bottom-left: PostgreSQL outbox and spool to shared-bot outbound to Mattermost; Mattermost back through inbound catch-up into Cooperation as body-free notices.

Manual harnesses sit under worker serve with explicit check-in/ack; no edge crosses a node; labels clear their routes in both themes; three cards carry release, capability matrix and accountability rules.
limitations: At 1440x900 node sublabels project near 6.7px: legible but small; the title wraps to two lines.
The repair-push route runs just above the server boundary's top edge; it is distinct but close.
At 390x844 the leftmost toolbar button is cut off and the diagram opens at desktop scale in its pan/zoom stage; narrow is readable only by panning. Archify targets desktop; not repaired.
Search, focus, passport, presentation and export interactions are not covered by this screenshot review.

corrections: First candidate: two vertical relationship labels overlapped their source nodes and the Mattermost catch-up route shared the outbound corridor; set labelAt on the two vertical labels and routed catch-up from Mattermost's top.
A 1500px viewBox failed desktop readability (5.58px projected text); relaid out to 1360x630.
The worker-host boundary left the canvas; shifted all columns 10px left.
